goodToKnow: Die Einkehr has two senses. On hikes, it's a stop for food and drink at an inn or hut: Einkehrmöglichkeit unterwegs, in einer Hütte einkehren. Spiritually, innere Einkehr is reflection or contemplation, as in a Besinnungstag or retreat. Einkehren also means to return: Ruhe kehrt ein. It has no plural.
